questions.question: In the context of India’s defence diplomacy, the bilateral maritime exercise KONKAN 25 primarily aims to:

options.text: Enhance joint anti-terror operations along the Indian Ocean littorals.
Facilitate logistics sharing and port access under the Logistics Exchange Memorandum of Agreement (LEMOA).
Conduct amphibious landings and humanitarian assistance operations in the Bay of Bengal.
Improve interoperability, tactical coordination, and maritime cooperation between the Indian and UK navies.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The sea phase of the bilateral maritime exercise KONKAN 25 between the Indian Navy and the United Kingdom’s Royal Navy concluded this week after a series of high-tempo naval operations aimed at strengthening interoperability and maritime partnership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Definition & Objective:** Exercise KONKAN is an annual bilateral naval exercise between India and the United Kingdom. It seeks to enhance interoperability, operational readiness, and maritime cooperation between the two navies. **Hence, Option D is correct. **
 
• Exercise Features (KONKAN 25): The 2025 edition included complex tactical drills, air defence, surface and anti-submarine warfare, and underway replenishment operations. These high-tempo exercises simulate real-world maritime contingencies to strengthen joint capabilities.
 
• Operational Context: The sea phase followed harbour interactions and concluded with a ceremonial steam-past, demonstrating traditional naval courtesies.
 
• Strategic Importance:
 
 
• Reinforces India–UK maritime cooperation under their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.
 
• Supports India’s ‘Security and Growth for All in the Region’ (SAGAR) vision and promotes a rules-based Indo-Pacific order.
 
• Showcases the Indian Navy’s growing blue-water capabilities and joint operational synergy with NATO navies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other India–UK Military Engagements:
 
 
• *Exercise Ajeya Warrior* – Army level
 
• *Exercise Indradhanush* – Air Force level
 
• *KONKAN* – Naval level
 
 
 
• Historical Note:
 
 
• The KONKAN series began in 2004 and alternates between Indian and UK waters.
 
• It is named after the Konkan coast, symbolising India’s western maritime frontier.
 
 
 
• Broader Context:
 
 
• India’s multilateral maritime exercises include MALABAR (with QUAD), VARUNA (with France), and SIMBEX (with Singapore).
 
• These exercises collectively strengthen India’s role as a net security provider in the Indo-Pacific.

questions.question: What is the name of the special exercise started by BSF to thwart infiltration attempts during winter on the Indo-Pak border in Jaisalmer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Sard Hawa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Border Security Force (BSF) launched 'Operation Sard Hawa' on January 22, 2025, to prevent infiltration attempts along the Indo-Pak border in Jaisalmer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Operation Sard Hawa' is conducted during winter to address reduced visibility caused by dense fog.**
 
• Patrolling is enhanced using state-of-the-art weapons, advanced technical instruments, and camels for inaccessible areas.
 
• The operation strengthens border surveillance and involves coordination with intelligence agencies to monitor suspicious activities.
 
• **It complements 'Operation Garam Hawa,' which is conducted during the summer months.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Operation Garam Hawa**__

 __
 
• BSF conducts this operation in summer to tackle challenges like heat and heightened border activity.
 
 
 
• **BSF's Role**__
 
 
• The Border Security Force is India's primary border-guarding organization tasked with securing international borders.
 
• It plays a vital role in counter-infiltration and counter-terrorism operations.
 
• The Border Security Force (BSF) is a central armed police force in India under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• It is responsible for guarding India’s borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh.
 
• It was formed in the wake of the Indo-Pak War of 1965 to ensure the security of India’s borders and related matters.
 
• Motto: Jīvana Paryanta Kartavya.
 
• Director General: Daljit Singh Chaudhary,.

questions.question: The hypersonic missile powered by a scramjet engine will travel above what speed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mach 5.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **DRDO successfully conducted a ground test of a scramjet combustor for 120 seconds.**
 
• The test used an active-cooled scramjet engine, achieving stable combustion with advanced techniques.
 
• Hypersonic missiles using scramjet engines can travel at speeds above Mach 5.
 
• The indigenous scramjet engine used innovative fuel and advanced Thermal Barrier Coatings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hypersonic missiles travel at speeds greater than Mach 5, enabling them to evade advanced air defense systems.**
 
• The scramjet engine's active cooling and flame stabilization techniques ensure stable combustion at high speeds.
 
• Innovative indigenous technologies like scramjet fuel and Thermal Barrier Coatings enhance the engine's performance.
 
• This test signifies India's advancement in hypersonic technology for defense applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Scramjet Engine__

 __
 
• A scramjet (Supersonic Combustion Ramjet) engine operates efficiently at hypersonic speeds.
 
• It compresses air entering at supersonic speeds, mixing it with fuel to achieve combustion without slowing the airflow.
 
 
 
• Hypersonic Missiles__
 
 
• Missiles traveling above Mach 5 are classified as hypersonic.
 
• These missiles offer strategic advantages due to their high speed and ability to evade interception.

questions.question: What significant document did Defence Minister Rajnath Singh release, aimed at simplifying procedures and increasing transparency in defense procurement?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh released the Defence Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025, which will be effective from 1st November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The new manual will facilitate procurement worth approximately one lakh crore rupees for the three Services and other defence establishments.
 
• **The DPM 2025 aims to simplify defence procurement procedures and ensure uniformity in the functioning of the Armed Forces.**
 
• **The manual will promote fairness, transparency, and accountability in procurement, benefiting Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and start-ups in defence manufacturing.**
 
• **It was developed through close consultation with services and other stakeholders to ensure its effectiveness in operational preparedness.**
 
• **The new manual will streamline procurement processes for the armed forces, facilitating their operational needs efficiently and effectively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Defence Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025**__

 __
 
• It is designed to enhance the efficiency of the defence procurement system, ensuring that the armed forces acquire necessary goods and services in a timely and cost-effective manner.
 
• The manual also seeks to improve the participation of domestic players, especially MSMEs, in defence contracts, fostering the growth of indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Consultation Process**__
 __
 
• The manual was developed in close collaboration with various defence services and stakeholders, ensuring its alignment with the current and future needs of the Indian armed forces.
 
 
 
• **Opportunities for MSMEs and Start-ups**__
 
 
• One of the key highlights of the new manual is the encouragement for MSMEs and start-ups to be more involved in the defence sector, ensuring more inclusive growth in defence technology and manufacturing.

questions.question: India ranked 4th in the Global Firepower Index 2025. Which country topped the Global Firepower Index 2025?

__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

• The **Global Firepower Index** evaluates **military power** based on **conventional capabilities**, not nuclear strength, covering over 60 parameters such as **manpower**, **natural resources**, **finance**, and **geography**.
 
• The ideal score is **0.0000**, indicating perfect military strength, which no country possesses.

• India was ranked **145th** in the world for **helicopter carrier strength** and **mine warfare capability** in the sea.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** is released annually by **Globalfirepower.com** since 2006, comparing **145 countries** based on their **war-making capabilities** across land, sea, and air.

questions.question: Which fighter aircraft was officially decommissioned by the Indian Air Force on 26 September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**MiG-21.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India formally decommissioned the iconic MiG-21 fighter aircraft on 26 September 2025 at Air Force Station Chandigarh, marking the end of a 62-year era in the IAF.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The MiG-21 was first inducted into the IAF in 1963 at Chandigarh Air Force Station and over 870 aircraft were procured over decades.**
 
• **It participated in major operations including the 1965 & 1971 wars with Pakistan, the 1999 Kargil Conflict, and the 2019 Balakot Airstrikes.**
 
• **The final operational flight took place on 24 September 2025, and the last squadron operating the aircraft was No. 23 Squadron “Panthers.”**
 
• **Decommissioning paves the way for IAF modernisation, including expansion of Tejas squadrons, additional Rafale jets, and future platforms like AMCA and MRFA projects.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Historical Significance__

 __
 
• The MiG-21 was India’s first supersonic fighter aircraft, introduced by the Soviet Union, and played a pivotal role in shaping the country’s air defence capabilities during the Cold War.
 
 
 
• Legacy Operations__
 __
 
• Known for speed, maneuverability, and agility, the MiG-21 served as the backbone of IAF for decades despite the induction of modern aircraft like Su-30MKI, Rafale, and Tejas LCA.
 
 
 
• Modernisation Impact__
 __
 
• The retirement enables the IAF to focus on indigenized and technologically advanced fighter platforms, moving away from Cold War-era imports.
 
 
 
• Ceremony Attendees__
 
 
• Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Chief of Defence Staff Gen Anil Chauhan, Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi, and Navy Chief Admiral Dinesh K. Tripathi attended the decommissioning ceremony.

questions.question: Which five countries are the top arms importers according to SIPRI in 2020-24?

options.text: Ukraine, India, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan
Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Russia, Germany, France
India, Israel, Japan, Saudi Arabia, France

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ukraine, India, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• According to the Sweden-based Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI), Ukraine became the world’s largest importer of major arms in the period 2020–24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Ukraine** became the **world’s largest importer of major arms** between **2020–24** (according to **Stockholm International Peace Research Institute** - **SIPRI**).
 
• The **top five arms importers** are **Ukraine**, **India**, **Qatar**, **Saudi Arabia**, and **Pakistan**, accounting for **35%** of global arms imports.
 
• The **top five arms exporters** are **USA**, **France**, **Russia**, **China**, and **Germany**, contributing **72%** of global arms exports.
 
• **USA** increased its share of global arms exports to **43%**, while **Russia’s arms exports** declined by **64%**.
 
• **China’s share** of global arms exports was **5.9%** in 2020–24, slightly declining from **2015–19**.
 
• **India** was the **second-largest arms importer** in 2020–24, with a **9.3% decrease** in imports compared to 2015–19.
 
• The largest share of **India's arms imports** (36%) came from **Russia**, significantly reduced from 55% in 2015–19 and 72% in 2010–14.
 
• **India** contracted major military deals with **France**, including **36 Rafale jets** and **six Scorpene-class submarines**.
 
• **Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)**: An independent research institute based in **Stockholm, Sweden**, established in **1966**, focused on **conflict**, **armaments**, **arms control**, and **disarmament**.

questions.question: Recently, India’s homegrown Astra Missile was successfully test-fired from the Tejas LCA AF MK1 off the Odisha coast. The missile is a type of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Beyond Visual Range air-to-air missile**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s homegrown Astra BVRAAM was successfully test-fired from the Tejas LCA AF MK1 off the Odisha coast, achieving a direct hit on a flying target.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Developed by DRDO, Astra can engage targets over 100 km away with advanced guidance & precision, strengthening India's air defense.
 
• The successful test moves India closer to inducting the LCA AF MK1A, enhancing indigenous defense capabilities.

 The missile release was successfully carried out from the aircraft at an altitude of about 20,000 ft.
 
 
• All the objectives of the test were met.
 
 
 
• ASTRA, a state-of-the-art BVR air-to-air missile to engage and destroy highly maneuvering supersonic aerial targets, is designed and developed by **Defence Research and Development Laboratory (DRDL)**, **Research Centre Imarat (RCI) **and other laboratories of DRDO.
 
• The indigenous Astra BVR firing from home grown Tejas fighter is a major step towards ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’.
